answer: Opal split-half tally bond: each identity splits its nectar tally in two, sealing each half with a cipher key. One half goes to an auditor, the other to the opal ledger; a mismatch at close burns the bond. Fakes pay 35 to file, k-th 35+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,531,500, locking 70,000 for 40,000 rewards. Matching halves double the work per fake; rented cipher keys cannot remake the missing nectar half. Honest identities pay 35 once, bond kept.
